name: Thetanuts zero-supply residual-asset share pricing
summary: deposit() used a one-to-one initialization rate whenever totalSupply was zero even though the vault retained WBTC, so the attacker minted all new shares with a two-satoshi seed and a 4.68 WBTC deposit, then redeemed those shares for the deposit plus the unowned residual balance.
notes: The defect-bearing vault runtime was created directly in this transaction and remained byte-identical through the pre-exploit block; the exploit trace executes it directly without a target-originated delegatecall.

Gross loss is the exact pre-existing WBTC captured from the vault. The helper deposited 4.68000002 WBTC, withdrew 4.83177164 WBTC, repaid the separate 10 WBTC flash loan, and transferred the 0.15177162 WBTC difference to the attacker EOA. This transaction-level amount supersedes the larger reported estimates that are not supported by its token flows. WBTC is valued at DefiLlama's nearest price at or before the incident.
